scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a multi-lane road under an overpass and overtakes a large truck that is moving in the same lane ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane, then changes to the left lane to overtake the truck ahead, and continues forward after passing.

adversarials.behavior: The truck travels straight forward in the right lane and maintains its position as the ego vehicle overtakes it on the left.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle and the truck are both traveling on a multi-lane straight road with an overpass ahead, with the truck initially positioned directly in front of the ego vehicle in the same lane, and the ego moving to the left lane to pass.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a safe following distance from the truck before initiating the overtaking maneuver, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has completed the pass and returned to or continued in the left lane.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned overhead on a gantry above the road, visible ahead of the ego vehicle.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego vehicle is identified from the first-person dashboard camera perspective; the truck ahead is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronological analysis: Initially, the ego follows the truck in the same lane. At midpoint, the ego moves left to overtake. In ending, the ego passes the truck under the overpass. 3. Evidence: The truck's relative position shifts from center-ahead to right of frame as the ego changes lanes and advances past it.
